about: At age 45, four consecutive 30-capsule supplies of Celebrex at one capsule daily cover 18 November 2025 through 17 March 2026.
At age 64, two 56-tablet supplies of Naprosyn SR at one tablet daily cover 7 January through 28 April 2026 with no uncovered days.
Skin gel supplies do not count, and the two oral diclofenac supplies document separate courses of up to ten days each.
